title: YUCG Prospect List
description: Company-level outreach targets for the YUCG outreach coordinator. Source of truth: data/YUCG_Prospect_List.xlsx

sheet.description: Primary data worksheet (active sheet in the canonical file)

header.description: Exact column header in the spreadsheet

field.description: SQLite column on yucg_prospect_targets (or extra_json key for extensions)

columns.description: Target organization name; unique key for sync upserts
Industry or segment label (e.g. Regional Aircraft OEM)
Rationale for YUCG fit, proof points, and student project angles
Recommended outreach narrative or project theme
Yale-specific connection or YUCG credential to lead with
Outreach persona bucket (e.g. VP Business Development, Studio Strategy)
Specific job title to hunt for at the company
Brief rationale tied to Why Attractive and scoring weights
Public page or LinkedIn/SEC search template for contact verification
One-sentence opening angle for first outreach
Where to find the target (conferences, alumni, press, etc.)

database.extra_columns_policy: Unknown spreadsheet columns are stored in extra_json during sync until schema and migrations add dedicated fields

related_tables.yucgoutreach_prospects: Individual people discovered during a run (person-level, not spreadsheet seed)
related_tables.contacts: CRM contacts; populated via import from discovery or manual entry
